note: Pathname.new coerced every argument with `to_s`, so non-Strings answered where CRuby raises TypeError and an object with a distinct to_path produced the wrong path. It now runs CRuby's `File.path` conversion — `rb_get_path_check_to_string` then `StringValue` — and rewrites any TypeError with CRuby's `Pathname.new requires a String, #to_path or #to_str`, keeping a null byte an ArgumentError. Compared with CRuby 4.0.5.
